description: The plain-HTTP decision and its proxy rule, shared by the Python and TypeScript clients. envProxy: for an http:// request URL, whether an environment proxy routes it under the shared rule. Proxy variables: a request is routed when HTTP_PROXY, http_proxy, ALL_PROXY or all_proxy (any letter case of the name, a non-empty value) is set; HTTPS_PROXY alone does not route http://. NO_PROXY value: the entry named no_proxy of urllib.request.getproxies_environment: a variable named no_proxy in any letter case with a non-empty value sets it (the last in the environment's order); a variable whose name ends in lower-case _proxy (no_proxy, NO_proxy) then replaces it, and when its value is empty removes it, so an empty no_proxy leaves no exemption even when NO_PROXY is set. Exemption: urllib.request.proxy_bypass_environment on the host string. The whole value * exempts every host; otherwise each comma-separated entry, trimmed, without leading dots and lower-case, exempts the host when it equals the host or the host:port form, or is a dot-separated suffix of either; a * inside a longer list or a name is a literal; CIDR ranges are not supported. Host string: lower-case ASCII (IDNA) host, an IPv6 address in brackets, the trailing dot of a name kept (example.com. does not match the entry example.com), then :port only when the URL as written has a port, with the port's digits exactly as written (08 is not 8) and a default port written out kept. libraryEnvProxy and libraryDecisions (Python clients): the rows where the router of httpx or requests proxies a request the shared rule exempts; a client counts a request as proxied when the shared rule or its library says so. decisions: the outcome for credentials sent to a URL; opt-in is allowInsecureHttp when not null, else FI_ALLOW_INSECURE_HTTP exactly 1 in env; callerProxied is a proxy on the caller's own client, session or dispatcher. Loopback hosts are not refused, and the opt-in does not apply to a Future AGI host (a trailing dot included), to an environment proxy or to a caller proxy. hostShapes: a plain-HTTP URL with no host, with a backslash or a percent-encoded backslash before its path, with user info before the host (any scheme, https included), or with an @ after its authority has reason ambiguous_host and is refused whatever the opt-in, loopback included; rows with the other reasons are controls. channelPorts: a channel URL's port is 1 to 5 ASCII digits naming 1 to 65535, read as a decimal number, so leading zeros are accepted and 000080 (six digits) is refused. Generated by scripts/gen_proxy_env_fixture.py from urllib.request, ipaddress, httpx and requests, not from the clients' own rule; the Python and TypeScript tests read the same rows.
